sentences.text: Learned CICL, who is detained in connection with North Lakhimpur P.S. Case No. 290/2023 under Section 376(2)(i) of the IPC, r/w Section 6 of the POCSO Act.

Page No.# 2/2 It is submitted that the petitioner's detained son is a child in conflict with law on the date of the alleged occurrence and in respect of the age of the said child, the petitioner's mother has produced a certificate issued by Pub-Sonapur Primary School, showing his father's name as Md.
Samar Ali, resident of Reserve village, P.O.- Sonapur, P.S.- Bihpuria, showing the date of birth as 01.01.2009, whereas from the petition, it appears that he is the son of one Samir Uddin, resident of Sonapur Reserve under Bihpuria P.S., district Lakhimpur.

In view of the above and as submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner, the mother of CICL shall approach the learned Special Judge (POCSO Act), Lakhimpur, North Lakhimpur for consideration of his zimma/bail and on receipt of the bail application, it is provided that the learned Special Judge (POCSO Act), Lakhimpur, North Lakhimpur shall cause an enquiry to ascertain the actual age of the petitioner's son, who is presently lodged in Observation Home, Jorhat and if found him to be a CICL, appropriate order shall be passed under the provision of Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act.
